definition.body: A cepstral-magnitude is the magnitude component of cepstral coefficients after inverse Fourier transform of log-magnitude spectrum, representing the envelope-like contribution of the signal in quefrency domain. Parameters: quefrency index, magnitude of cepstral coefficient, liftering window, frame length.
